how_this_was_built: Every rate below was read from the provider's own public pricing page on 2026-08-19; source_reference is the exact URL.
These are published LIST prices for the standard tier. They are not your account's negotiated rate, not batch pricing, and not a quote.
Prices change without notice. Re-verify before quoting a budget and bump verified_at when you do.

reasoning_output is set equal to output for every model here, because none of these providers bills reasoning tokens on a separate line. That is a modelling decision recorded per model, not a vendor line item.

cache_write = the page's '5m Cache Write' column; the 1h variant is $10/MTok if you need longer retention
reasoning_output = output (not billed separately)

models.rate_basis: published list price, PEAK-hour rate (the conservative half of the two)
mapping_notes: Off-peak rates are half of these. Peak is 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC; everything else is off-peak.
Peak is used here on purpose: a budget built on off-peak rates is only valid if the run is guaranteed to avoid peak hours, and an agentic run lasting hours cannot guarantee that.

not_included: Kimi / Moonshot and Qwen / Alibaba Cloud are listed under pending_verification below. Their rates are absent, not guessed.
Subscription-equivalent pricing (Claude Code / Codex seats) is a different billing model and is deliberately absent: converting a seat price into a per-token rate would be an invention.

pending_verification.why: These providers publish model catalogues at URLs that can be read, but their per-token rates are not on those pages. Third-party aggregators do carry numbers; this registry does not accept them, because a rate without vendor provenance fails the same check that rejects a null.
